name: 별시계 천장방
prompt: Create a high-end cinematic environment artwork for an educational fantasy escape-room game. Landscape 3:2, AAA realistic 3D game environment / film production rendering, physically plausible lighting, richly detailed materials, atmospheric perspective. Inspired by a moonlit Scottish gothic castle: cool dark teal-blue night light with warm golden lantern light. NOT an illustration, NOT vector, NOT cartoon, NOT low-poly. Beautiful and inviting for children without childish styling. No people, no creatures in the foreground, no text, no letters, no UI, no watermark. Keep the lower central foreground relatively open; interactive 3D props are placed in front later. Natural 40mm eye-level camera, horizon in the upper middle, subtle depth of field. SCENE: Upward-tilted shot beneath a vast star-clock ceiling, its curved glass lens projecting drifting constellations of light onto the chamber below. Thin brass gear-hands sweep slowly across an engraved dial ring set into the stone wall, ticking shadows across warm amber-lit floor tiles. Cool teal light pools directly under the lens. Open lower-central foreground, intricate clockwork detail, atmospheric haze, no people, no text, no UI.
